Body.Content:
Makers can configure the modern Data Grid in canvas apps to load more records automatically as users scroll or display numbered pages with a configurable page size. Existing apps retain their current behavior unless makers enable pagination. Connector and formula delegation limits still apply.

More info: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-apps/maker/canvas-apps/controls/modern-controls/modern-control-data-grid

GA date: December CY2026
